source.what: Learn the Signs. Act Early. developmental milestone checklists, the lists for 4 years and 5 years

skills.name: Pretends to be something else during play
skills.example: a teacher, a superhero, a dog

skills.name: Asks to go play with children if none are around
Comforts others who are hurt or sad
Avoids danger
skills.example: not jumping from tall heights at the playground

skills.name: Likes to be a helper
Changes behavior based on where she is
skills.example: a place of worship, the library, the playground

skills.name: Says sentences with four or more words
Says some words from a song, story or nursery rhyme
Talks about at least one thing that happened during her day
Answers simple questions
skills.example: What is a coat for? What is a crayon for?

skills.name: Names a few colors of items
Tells what comes next in a well-known story
Draws a person with three or more body parts
Catches a large ball most of the time
Serves herself food or pours water, with an adult watching
Unbuttons some buttons
Holds a crayon or pencil between fingers and thumb, not a fist
Follows rules or takes turns when playing games with other children
Sings, dances or acts for you
Does simple chores at home
skills.example: matching socks, clearing the table after eating

skills.name: Tells a story she heard or made up, with at least two events
skills.example: a cat was stuck in a tree and a firefighter saved it

skills.name: Answers simple questions about a book or story after you read or tell it
Keeps a conversation going with more than three back-and-forth exchanges
Uses or recognizes simple rhymes
skills.example: bat and cat, ball and tall

skills.name: Counts to 10
Names some numbers between 1 and 5 when you point to them
Uses words about time
Pays attention for 5 to 10 minutes during an activity
skills.example: story time, arts and crafts; screen time does not count

skills.name: Writes some letters in her name
Names some letters when you point to them
Buttons some buttons
Hops on one foot
